purpose: Machine-readable statistical terminology for classification of explicitly reported clinical-trial results; never a basis for inventing or selecting an unreported method.
global_rules: Preserve the source's statistical label and definition.
Do not infer a test or model from the data shape alone.
Do not convert between effect measures or uncertainty measures unless an approved derivation rule explicitly authorizes it.
Keep arm-level summaries, between-arm effects, tests, analysis populations, covariates, multiplicity and provenance distinct.

descriptive_and_uncertainty.MEAN: Arithmetic average reported for a defined arm, population and timepoint.
descriptive_and_uncertainty.SD: Between-participant variability around a mean; not precision of the mean.
descriptive_and_uncertainty.SE: Precision measure for an estimate; not interchangeable with SD.
descriptive_and_uncertainty.MEDIAN: Middle observed value; store distribution bounds according to their actual label.
descriptive_and_uncertainty.IQR: Interval from Q1 to Q3 describing the middle half of observations; not a confidence interval.
descriptive_and_uncertainty.RANGE: Reported minimum to maximum observations; not IQR or confidence limits.
descriptive_and_uncertainty.CONFIDENCE_INTERVAL: Frequentist interval for a defined estimate and confidence level; preserve estimate, level and both limits.
descriptive_and_uncertainty.GEOMETRIC_MEAN: Central value on a multiplicative scale, commonly obtained after log transformation; preserve the source transformation and back-transformation semantics.
descriptive_and_uncertainty.LEAST_SQUARES_MEAN: Model-adjusted mean; preserve model, covariates and contrast when reported. Do not treat it as a raw mean.

effect_measures.MEAN_DIFFERENCE: Difference between two means on the original scale.
effect_measures.STANDARDIZED_MEAN_DIFFERENCE: Difference in means expressed in pooled standard-deviation units; preserve the named estimator if reported.
effect_measures.RISK_RATIO: Ratio of event risks/proportions between groups.
effect_measures.ODDS_RATIO: Ratio of event odds between groups; not a risk ratio.
effect_measures.HAZARD_RATIO: Relative instantaneous event hazard from a time-to-event model; not an odds or risk ratio.
effect_measures.INCIDENCE_RATE_RATIO: Ratio of event rates using person-time or another reported exposure denominator.
effect_measures.RATIO_OF_MEANS: Ratio of group means or geometric means; preserve whether it was log-modelled and back-transformed.
effect_measures.LOG_TRANSFORMED_RELATIVE_PERCENTAGE_CHAN: Published relative percentage effect from a log-scale model; preserve arm estimates and the model contrast independently.
effect_measures.NUMBER_NEEDED_TO_TREAT: Reported reciprocal absolute-effect summary; preserve direction, horizon and CI, and never calculate it unless explicitly authorized.

outcome_data_types.CONTINUOUS: Requires the reported metric (final, change, percent change or other), arm/population/timepoint, central estimate and actual uncertainty/dispersion type.
outcome_data_types.BINARY: Requires event count and denominator for each arm when printed, plus any published comparison estimate.
outcome_data_types.COUNT_OR_RATE: Requires event count, exposure/person-time denominator and the reported count/rate model or effect when available.
outcome_data_types.TIME_TO_EVENT: Requires event definition, time origin/horizon, analysis population, effect/CI, censoring or number-at-risk details when explicitly printed, and the reported model/test.
outcome_data_types.ORDINAL: Requires category/scale direction, cut point or full distribution and the reported ordinal method/effect.
outcome_data_types.REPEATED_MEASURES: Requires scheduled timepoints, correlation/repeated structure, analysis population and model-based contrast when reported.

tests_and_models.INDEPENDENT_T_TEST: Reported parametric comparison of two independent group means.
tests_and_models.PAIRED_T_TEST: Reported parametric comparison of paired or repeated measurements within matched units.
tests_and_models.ANOVA: Reported analysis comparing means across factors/groups; preserve factors and contrast.
tests_and_models.ANCOVA: Reported model comparing outcomes while adjusting for baseline or other covariates; preserve covariates and adjusted effect.
tests_and_models.MMRM: Reported mixed model for repeated measures; preserve repeated structure, visits, covariance details and estimand when available.
tests_and_models.MANN_WHITNEY_U: Reported rank-based comparison of independent groups; do not label its result a median difference unless the paper does.
tests_and_models.WILCOXON_SIGNED_RANK: Reported rank-based comparison of paired measurements.
tests_and_models.CHI_SQUARED: Reported large-sample test of categorical association/proportions.
tests_and_models.FISHER_EXACT: Reported exact test for a categorical contingency table.
tests_and_models.LOGISTIC_REGRESSION: Reported model for a binary outcome, commonly producing an odds ratio; preserve covariates and link function if stated.
tests_and_models.COX_PROPORTIONAL_HAZARDS: Reported time-to-event regression commonly producing a hazard ratio; preserve covariates and proportional-hazards context.
tests_and_models.LOG_RANK: Reported test comparing survival/event-time curves; it does not itself define a hazard ratio.
tests_and_models.POISSON_REGRESSION: Reported count/rate model; preserve offset/exposure and overdispersion handling if stated.
tests_and_models.NEGATIVE_BINOMIAL_REGRESSION: Reported overdispersed count/rate model; preserve exposure and effect definition.
tests_and_models.GEE: Reported population-averaged model for correlated observations; preserve family, link and clustering unit.
tests_and_models.KAPLAN_MEIER: Reported nonparametric survival estimate; preserve time horizon, censoring context and directly printed values only.

inference_rules.p_value: Store operator and numeric value separately, with sidedness, comparison, method and nominal/adjusted status.
inference_rules.multiplicity: Preserve hierarchy, alpha allocation, gatekeeping or adjustment method. After a failed gate, do not fabricate tests that were not performed.
inference_rules.subgroup: Preserve subgroup definition and interaction p-value separately from within-subgroup effects; a significant within-subgroup result does not prove interaction.
inference_rules.missing_data: Preserve the stated handling or imputation method and the analysis population; do not infer a missingness mechanism.
inference_rules.sensitivity_analysis: Keep sensitivity and supplementary analyses distinct from the main estimator and estimand.
inference_rules.estimand: When reported, preserve population, treatment conditions, variable/endpoint, intercurrent-event strategy and population-level summary.
